answer: New agents start on a flat mesa of low influence, and any attempt to spin up many fake identities causes a visible ripple in the bond ledger, since each clone must post real collateral. Sybil resistance can work through a stake-weighted identity bridge: each agent must lock a bond tied to a verified off-chain credential before joining the network. Attackers thus face rising capital costs proportional to the number of identities, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0236 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
